text: Again, when on a time Sophocles, who was his fellow-commissioner in the generalship, was going on board with him, and praised the beauty of a youth they met with in the way to the ship, "Sophocles," said he, "a general ought not only to have clean hands, but also clean eyes."
author: Plutarch
speaker: Pericles
translation: John Dryden et al., rev. Arthur Hugh Clough, 1864
